description: Issue #141 hard-rejection recall check (ADR 0001 guard 1): the primary pass raises the preserve-liability-cap hard rejection and the critic DROPs it. A critic may add a hard rejection but never remove one, so the final review must still REQUEST_CHANGE and carry the issue (provenance primary-retained). A retained issue ships without the primary's edit (issue #138), so the flag-only finding is expected and edits_must_apply is false.
